issue.body:
I am very excited with Starlette and I am building stuff with hellish speed. It is a good chance to thank you for the high-quality you provide, guys.

As part of this, I am trying to write some automation tests for my API and if I understand correctly, I see that you recommend using the TestClient for it? Could you point me to a more detailed example, as the one in the documentation is a bit basic, if any?
What is your view on unit testing Starlette routes? I am a bit confused that you have minimal references to unit testing in starlette.io. After that, I suppose pytest-asyncio is the suggested way to unit test?

Thanks,
Periklis
issue.title: Unit testing with starlette
